data.name: Delicious - Emily's Hopes and Fears
data.detailed_description:
Fan Quotes

5 STARS: “I don't normally buy games, but your games are a big exception. Definitely worth the money, because it's not just talent you bring to the table, but heart as well.”

5 STARS: "I’m so excited to have another Emily game. I just love the story lines and the characters. Thank you for another job well done. I own all the Emily delicious games and cannot wait for more."


Características

  • enjoy the 12th season of the Delicious time management game series
  • complete 65 challenging yet curiously relaxing story levels, plus 32 extra challenges
  • jump into an amazing adventure, and help Patrick find the magical flower
  • help Emily hold on to hope in times of uncertainty and fear, and collect presents to cheer up Paige


Acerca do jogo

"Delicious - Emily's Hopes and Fears takes you on an adventure like no other before... During the hottest summer of the century, Paige fights to survive a mysterious disease. While Emily stays unwaveringly by her struggling daughter’s side, Patrick embarks on an epic journey through the blistering cold in search of the only cure: a magical flower… Can he save his little girl? "

Enjoy other Delicious - Emily games:
  • Delicious - Emily's Home Sweet Home
  • Delicious - Emily's New Beginning
  • Delicious - Emily's Honeymoon Cruise
  • Delicious - Emily's Wonder Wedding
  • Delicious - Emily's True Love

reviews.review:
[i]Note: so far, I have completed only two chapters in Steam, but I finished the game on my mobile yesterday – had to switch devices because I am ill and was not able to use my laptop.[/i]

I still remember the time when about 10 years ago I started playing the first Delicious game [i](which, as I have recently found out, was the fourth installment and not the first as I thought)[/i]. I immediately fell in love with charming Emily, her bright personality and love for cooking.  

[b]Delicious - Emily's Hopes and Fears[/b] is the twelfth game in the series, and to my mind, it is the most dramatic one story-wise. We will meet Emily, Patrick and their daughter Paige once again, as well as some other beloved characters like Francois and the Napoli couple. 

[h1]The Story[/h1]

It is an extremely hot summer season, and the O'Malleys are enjoying their time outdoors. Patrick is more keen on repairing his motorbike than going anywhere, and Emily practically has to drag him out to the lake. All days are beautiful and relaxing, and in the evening, Patrick reads Paige stories from his grandfather’s diary. The man was a brave adventurer and never shied away from danger.  

One day the O'Malley family goes back to the lake, where Evelyn Napoli and Francois have set up a little restaurant. After swimming, Paige all of a sudden faints in front of her parents. Later she develops high fever and strange blue spots on her skin appear. No one knows what is going on, even the doctors. Seeing the blue spots, Patrick remembers that he read about the same symptoms in his grandfather’s diary. Emily does not really believe in these stories, but her husband is adamant – if there is even the slightest hope to save Paige, he will go to the end of the world and find the mysterious Golden Lily.

Emily stays by her ill daughter’s side, and Patrick starts his adventure in search for the cure for this mysterious disease. On his way he will visit many interesting places, meet a lot of lovely (and not really) people, and test his own skills. Will he be able to survive and bring the flower to his daughter in time?

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1657641660

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]

Delicious is always true to its traditions, so if you have ever played one, you already know what to expect and how to play. 

As always, you have to serve customers by bringing them the right things, preferably as fast as possible, and then checking them out at the cash register. All customers have five hearts, which show us how much their like the services and what amount of money they will pay in the end. There are no gold hearts like in the later parts of the series, so I do not recommend making people wait – they will start losing hearts even if you have already completed their order and left them waiting at the cash register. There is only one way to return hearts: each chapter has specific entertainment, Eduardo with his guitar in the first one, a cute raccoon in the second, etc. There will also be a person to help you with cleaning most of the time.

You get extra points if you bring a full order, do it fast or complete several similar actions in a row. Also, each level has its own challenge and a cute mice that you should definitely catch (there is a relevant achievement). 

There are sixty-five story levels and thirty-two extra stages that help you earn gems to buy special presents for Paige. At some point, you will also have the chance to take a special photo for the album – the game will show you how.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1657640111

[h1]What I liked and disliked[/h1]

As I have already said. I think Emily's Hopes and Fears is the most dramatic part of the series. I felt really sorry for Paige when she got ill and rooted for Patrick all the time. Each chapter is very interesting and shows how even one person can change lives of many others. The game also talks a lot about family relationships and how we should cherish our loved ones instead of reminiscing about the past or being afraid of doing something new.

Each stage is very colorful and bright, and I absolutely loved how much attention is paid to even the smallest details. There are a lot of animated parts like falling leaves in the second chapter, people playing in the lake in the first, etc. Some parts can be interacted with – just try clicking on the little bird in the Lumber Mill and see what it has to say [i](yes, if you bother the bird fast and often enough it will share a funny line)[/i].

The characters are good, as always. Emily and Patrick are a happy couple that sometimes has arguments but they still love each other a lot. Paige is a charming little girl and not an entitled kid – she is very lively and smart but never annoying or definitely not spoiled. Other people ae also very lovable, except for some pretty rood lumberjacks in the second chapter.
The game is very easy to learn and to master, while all necessary actions are carefully explained in the tutorial. Even if you get stuck at some point, a red arrow will appear and show you what to do.

The only thing I have to complain about is that sometimes the game just does not notice me clicking on items, and this is not the first time I have this issue in these games. For example, I select a packet of crisps and then a glass of juice, but the character will pick up only the first product. This usually happens with items that require some time to be prepared, and yes, I wait for the right time to take them, so it is not the issue of not waiting enough – the game simply does not react. This can become annoying if you are in a hurry and the product gets spoiled. 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1653785991

[h1]Would I recommend this game?[/h1]

I can recommend [b]Delicious - Emily's Hopes and Fears[/b] to all fans of time-management games and the Delicious series. The gameplay is very entertaining, the story is both dramatic and heartwarming, the characters are interesting, all stages are very colorful with a lot of neat details, and music suits the atmosphere. I encountered only one problem, but it did not stop me from finishing the game.

All in all, Emily's Hopes and Fears is another great chapter in Emily’s story that you will definitely like.

[h1][url=http://store.steampowered.com/curator/32296668-Casual-Game-Reviews/] More reviews on our Curator Page
[/url][/h1]
